title: [CRY-10] DM groups have no defined exporter context, chain registration or countersigner
description: Review finding CRY-10: DM groups have no defined exporter context, chain registration or countersigner (lens CRY). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:125, spec/05-messaging.md:194, spec/05-messaging.md:202-204, spec/05-messaging.md:218, spec/10-relays.md:612. Fix: The access seed (05:202), channel token (05:194) and sealing key (05:218) all take `channelCID` as exporter context. A DM has no `channelCID`, and its `DMGroupCID` changes on each membership change (04:145). 04:125 gives a separate `dmGroupToken` with context `""`, but no access seed or sealing key for DMs. 05:204's countersign gate is "a current member of the channel under Space state", which does not exist for DMs, which "do not appear in any Space state document" (04:125). Nothing says which billing DID registers a DM chain. One note on the fix: using the MLS `group_id` as exporter context is compatible with 04:125's ban on deriving the token "from the MLS group ID". The exporter output still rotates per epoch, so the reworded rule must say "not derived from a constant value alone". Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
